Adds host-only falsifiers for missing probe sources/manifests/scripts, hard-coded Linux NDK prebuilt, full-island gating, missing quantized MatMul dtype/layout metadata, fused RMSNorm/GELU misuse, and rank/operand mismatches in probe sources.

research_semantics_consumed: primitive RMSNorm probe must avoid QNN_OP_RMS_NORM and declare QNN_OP_REDUCE_MEAN_PARAM_AXES over hidden axis 2
primitive GELU-tanh probe must avoid QNN_OP_GELU and lower tanh formula before multiplying by up activation
quantized tiny MatMul probe must declare UFIXED16 activation, UFIXED8 weight, UFIXED16 output, scale/zero-point fields, FullyConnected KEEP_DIMS, and MatMul transpose variant metadata
full Gemma FFN/residual island remains gated until the first three probes are present and ordered

pipeline_receiving_checklist: Generated package contains three probe source files plus full-island source, not only the monolithic full-island candidate.
Probe manifest stage_order is primitive RMSNorm, primitive GELU-tanh, quantized tiny MatMul, then full Gemma FFN/residual island.
Primitive RMSNorm probe source avoids QNN_OP_RMS_NORM and records QNN_OP_REDUCE_MEAN_PARAM_AXES, hidden axis 2, keep_dims, epsilon, and [1,1,2560] weight broadcast contract.
Primitive GELU-tanh probe source avoids QNN_OP_GELU and includes x2/x3/cubic/tanh/half-x lowering plus explicit gelu*up output multiply.
Quantized tiny MatMul probe source records UFIXED16 activation/output, UFIXED8 static weight, scale/zero-point/orientation, FullyConnected KEEP_DIMS, and MatMul transpose variant metadata.
Full-island script is gated on green.json for the first three probe stages.
Generated build scripts use ANDROID_NDK_PREBUILT override or host OS detection and no longer hard-code linux-x86_64 on macOS.
Generated build scripts fail closed with model_library_failure:ndk_prebuilt_compiler_missing when compiler is absent.
Quantized tiny MatMul metadata includes activation dtype, weight dtype, scale, zero-point, and orientation.
No raw selected blobs, model libraries, contexts, tensor outputs, profiles, checkpoints, adapters, or generated QNN payloads enter git.
